subject.title: Preserve aborted sessions across restart opt-in

question: Should OpenClaw accept `session.restartContinuation` as the opt-in contract for preserving aborted main-session ids across controlled Gateway restarts?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but adding another session config key and changing when killed/aborted terminal rows reuse a persisted session id is a compatibility-sensitive product contract, not a purely mechanical repair.

options.title: Close Until Sponsored
options.body: Close this PR now and leave the canonical issue open for a maintainer-sponsored opt-in or replacement design.

options.title: Sponsor The Opt-In
options.body: A maintainer can reopen or replace this PR if `session.restartContinuation` is accepted as the desired narrow contract.

options.title: Prefer Config-Free Recovery
options.body: Redirect the work toward current-main restart-recovery mechanisms that avoid adding another session config surface.

recommendation.title: Close Until Sponsored
recommendation.body: Close this PR now and leave the canonical issue open for a maintainer-sponsored opt-in or replacement design.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the terminal-main transcript reconciliation behavior that this PR modifies and are the strongest history signal for the narrow session freshness invariant.
